title: Net Loss for Central Weave BTO Development at Ang Mo Kio
what_it_is: Net Loss for Central Weave BTO Development at Ang Mo Kio

sections.label: CPF housing grants and land cost
sections.summary: Extending CPF housing grants to eligible buyers is estimated to raise the loss by $20 million to about $270 million, with land cost about $500 million.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: If we consider the Central Provident Fund (CPF) housing grants that HDB will extend to eligible buyers, the loss will increase further by an estimated $20 million, to about $270 million.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: The estimated land cost for the project is about $500 million.

sections.label: HDB Homeownership Programme deficit
sections.summary: HDB recorded a $3.85 billion deficit for its Homeownership Programme in FY2021/2022, averaging about $2.68 billion yearly from 2019 to 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: For the Financial Year (FY) 2021/2022, for example, HDB recorded a deficit of $3.85 billion for its Homeownership Programme.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: The average deficit incurred by HDB in the last three years from 2019 to 2021 was about $2.68 billion a year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: So, claims that HDB profits from the development and sale of HDB flats are false.
